novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is mechanistic: it proposes that repetition inflation is carried by an identifiable “familiarity/fluency” component “causally dissociable from the truth-value direction” whose ablation can “restore truth-tracking without removing the model’s ability to represent truth.” Searches using “LLM illusory truth effect repetition internal belief,” “in-context repeated claims truth confidence activation patching,” and “repetition fluency truth direction LLM” identify Susceptibility to Influence of Large Language Models (2023) as the closest behavioral precedent, while When Truth Is Overridden (2025) provides a nearby mechanistic precedent for context-induced overrides of factual knowledge. Moving from those works to a dose-dependent, truth-orthogonal repetition mechanism requires a new core relationship rather than merely changing the object or renaming a standard probe, although the behavioral phenomenon and intervention tools are established, supporting high but not paradigm-level novelty.
